headline: ATL @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.27 at SDP 4.35, with a projected total of 8.62. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: ATL moved +0.05 runs while SDP moved +0.69, changing the projected margin by -0.64 runs. The projected total climbed +0.75, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: JR Ritchie has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Samad Taylor, Michael Harris II, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jase Bowen, Rodolfo Durán because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
